scope: Instrumented native combat cycle with two staged beasts: candidate support is calculated in shadow, then the original support is always applied. Eligibility excludes non-Walking clips and active impact reaction; no candidate is integrated. Candidate and reference both run, so timing and FPS are not performance comparisons. Does not validate other biomes, visual differences, falling/recovery, all pose modifications or future integration.
